description: Quote the connected account's exact Gold price for the fantasy bestiary page workflow: turn an owned creature image into a fantasy bestiary page. Returns gold_cost, affordable and quote_token without starting a run, moderating, charging Gold or consuming a free sheet. After the user approves the price, call chargen_run_recipe_fantasy_bestiary_page with the same values and quote_token. For input rules, use chargen_get_recipe_fantasy_bestiary_page.
